# Overview

This notebook benchmarks three spatial transcriptomics deconvolution methods
— Cell2Location (C2L), RCTD, and SpatialDecon — on six Visium CRC samples
(two per metastasis group). The goal is to compare how each method's cell-type
estimates affect downstream pseudobulk differential expression.

**Samples:** 0 (LN_Mets), 10 (No_Mets), 11 (Distant_Mets), 38 (No_Mets), 80 (Distant_Mets), 97 (LN_Mets)

# 2. Cell Type Mapping

This mapping collapses the fine-grained c295 atlas labels into the broad
categories used for DE analysis. Same mapping as the CellChat/RCTD pipelines.

**Note on Tumor mapping:** The c295 atlas separates tumor cells from normal
epithelium based on 10x channel loading (tumor vs adjacent normal tissue) and
CNV-based classification — not expression clustering. Tumor cells are labeled
`Tumor cE01`, `Tumor cE02`, etc. in the C2L reference (caught by `^Tumor`).
In RCTD/SpatialDecon, the reference only has the non-neoplastic `cE01-cE11`
profiles. Since our Visium tissue is CRC and the CT/IM regions are
predominantly neoplastic, we map `cE*` → Tumor for all three methods. This is
a pragmatic assumption — RCTD and SpatialDecon cannot truly distinguish
malignant from non-malignant epithelium with this reference.

```{r cell_type_mapping}
map_c2l_to_celltype <- function(col_name) {
  clean <- gsub("meanscell_abundance_w_sf_", "", col_name)
  clean <- gsub("means_cell_abundance_w_sf_", "", clean)
  if (grepl("^Tumor", clean)) return("Tumor")
  # cE* (non-neoplastic epithelial subtypes) -> Tumor

  # In CRC Visium, epithelial signal in CT/IM is predominantly neoplastic.
  # The atlas does not cluster tumor cells into cE subtypes (see Pelka et al.);
  # tumor identity comes from sample-of-origin metadata and CNV classification.
  if (grepl("^cE", clean)) return("Tumor")
  if (grepl("^cS", clean)) {
    num <- as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", sub("\\s.*", "", clean)))
    if (!is.na(num)) {
      if (num >= 1 & num <= 14) return("Endothelial")
      if (num == 32) return("Smooth_muscle")
      if (num %in% c(27:31)) return("CAF")
      if (num == 26) return("Myofibroblast")
      if (num %in% c(22, 25)) return("Fibroblast")
      if (num %in% c(15:20)) return("Pericyte")
      if (num == 33) return("Schwann")
    }
    return("Fibroblast")
  }
  if (grepl("^cB", clean)) return("B_cell")
  if (grepl("^cP", clean)) return("Plasma")
  if (grepl("^cMA", clean)) return("Mast")
  if (grepl("^cM", clean)) {
    if (grepl("cM10", clean)) return("Granulocyte")
    if (grepl("cM01|cM02", clean)) return("Macrophage")
    return("DC")
  }
  if (grepl("^cTNI", clean)) {
    num <- as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", sub("\\s.*", "", clean)))
    if (!is.na(num)) {
      if (num >= 1 & num <= 7) return("CD4_T")
      if (num %in% c(8, 9)) return("Treg")
      if (num %in% c(10:13)) return("CD8_T")
      if (num %in% c(14:16)) return("CD8_T_exhausted")
      if (num %in% c(17, 18)) return("gdT")
      if (num %in% c(19:22)) return("Other_T")
      if (num %in% c(23:25)) return("NK")
      if (num == 26) return("ILC")
    }
    return("Other_T")
  }
  return("Other")
}
```

# 3. Load Data

## 3a. Load region annotations from h5ad-derived lookup

Region annotations (CT/IM/Stroma/Other) live in the h5ad files and were not
carried into the prepped `.rds` objects. We load them from a pre-generated
lookup CSV.

```{r load_regions}
region_lookup <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "region_lookup.csv"),
                          colClasses = c("character", "character", "character", "character"))
cat("Region lookup:", nrow(region_lookup), "rows\n")
cat("Samples:", paste(unique(region_lookup$sample_id), collapse = ", "), "\n")
print(table(region_lookup$region))
```

## 3b. Prepped samples — extract C2L abundances

```{r load_prepped}
prepped <- list()
c2l_all <- list()

for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
  cat("Loading prepped sample:", sid, "\n")
  prep <- readRDS(file.path(prep_dir, paste0("prep_", sid, ".rds")))
  prepped[[sid]] <- prep

  # C2L aggregated abundances (already broad categories from prep pipeline)
  c2l_agg <- as.data.frame(prep$c2l_agg)
  c2l_agg$barcode <- rownames(c2l_agg)
  c2l_agg$sample_id <- sid

  # Attach region from lookup
  rl <- region_lookup[region_lookup$sample_id == sid, ]
  region_vec <- rl$region
  names(region_vec) <- rl$barcode
  c2l_agg$region <- region_vec[c2l_agg$barcode]

  c2l_all[[sid]] <- c2l_agg
  cat("  Spots:", nrow(c2l_agg), " | C2L cell types:", ncol(prep$c2l_agg),
      " | IM spots:", sum(c2l_agg$region == "IM", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
}

cat("\nC2L column names (broad cell types):\n")
ct_cols <- setdiff(colnames(c2l_all[[1]]), c("barcode", "sample_id", "region"))
print(ct_cols)
```

## 3b. RCTD results — extract proportions

```{r load_rctd}
rctd_all <- list()

for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
  cat("Loading RCTD for sample:", sid, "\n")
  rctd_obj <- readRDS(file.path(rctd_dir, paste0("rctd_", sid, ".rds")))

  # Extract weights and normalize to proportions
  weights <- rctd_obj@results$weights
  weights_norm <- sweep(weights, 1, rowSums(weights), "/")
  weights_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(weights_norm))

  # Map fine c295 labels to broad categories
  fine_names <- colnames(weights_df)
  broad_names <- sapply(fine_names, map_c2l_to_celltype, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  # Aggregate proportions by broad category
  weights_broad <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(weights_df))
  for (bt in unique(broad_names)) {
    cols <- fine_names[broad_names == bt]
    if (length(cols) == 1) {
      weights_broad[[bt]] <- weights_df[[cols]]
    } else {
      weights_broad[[bt]] <- rowSums(weights_df[, cols, drop = FALSE])
    }
  }

  weights_broad$barcode <- rownames(weights_broad)
  weights_broad$sample_id <- sid

  # Attach region from lookup
  rl <- region_lookup[region_lookup$sample_id == sid, ]
  region_vec <- rl$region
  names(region_vec) <- rl$barcode
  weights_broad$region <- region_vec[weights_broad$barcode]

  rctd_all[[sid]] <- weights_broad
  cat("  Spots:", nrow(weights_broad), " | Broad types:",
      ncol(weights_broad) - 3, "\n")
}

cat("\nRCTD broad categories:\n")
print(setdiff(colnames(rctd_all[[1]]), c("barcode", "sample_id", "region")))
```

## 3c. Build SpatialDecon profile matrix from atlas

```{r build_spatialdecon_profile}
cat("Loading atlas...\n")
atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)

# Extract raw counts
counts_ref <- tryCatch(
  GetAssayData(atlas, layer = "counts"),
  error = function(e) atlas@assays$RNA@counts
)
if (ncol(counts_ref) == 0 || nrow(counts_ref) == 0) {
  counts_ref <- atlas@assays$RNA@counts
}
cat("Atlas:", nrow(counts_ref), "genes x", ncol(counts_ref), "cells\n")

# Map fine labels to broad
fine_labels <- as.character(atlas@meta.data$cl295v11SubFull)
fine_labels <- gsub("/", "_", fine_labels)
broad_labels <- sapply(fine_labels, map_c2l_to_celltype, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
names(broad_labels) <- colnames(counts_ref)

cat("Broad cell types in atlas:", length(unique(broad_labels)), "\n")
print(sort(table(broad_labels), decreasing = TRUE))

# Profile matrix: mean expression per broad cell type (genes x cell_types)
cat("\nBuilding profile matrix...\n")
unique_types <- sort(unique(broad_labels))
profile_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(counts_ref), ncol = length(unique_types),
                         dimnames = list(rownames(counts_ref), unique_types))

for (ct in unique_types) {
  ct_cells <- which(broad_labels == ct)
  if (length(ct_cells) > 0) {
    profile_matrix[, ct] <- Matrix::rowMeans(counts_ref[, ct_cells, drop = FALSE])
  }
}

cat("Profile matrix:", nrow(profile_matrix), "genes x", ncol(profile_matrix), "types\n")
rm(atlas, counts_ref, fine_labels, broad_labels); gc()
```

## 3d. Run SpatialDecon

```{r run_spatialdecon}
spatialdecon_all <- list()

for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
  cat("\n=== SpatialDecon on sample:", sid, "===\n")
  prep <- prepped[[sid]]

  # Normalized counts from Seurat
  norm_data <- tryCatch(
    as.matrix(GetAssayData(prep$seu, layer = "data", assay = "RNA")),
    error = function(e) as.matrix(GetAssayData(prep$seu, slot = "data", assay = "RNA"))
  )
  cat("  Norm data:", nrow(norm_data), "x", ncol(norm_data), "\n")

  # Intersect genes
  shared_genes <- intersect(rownames(profile_matrix), rownames(norm_data))
  cat("  Shared genes:", length(shared_genes), "\n")

  norm_sub <- norm_data[shared_genes, ]
  profile_sub <- profile_matrix[shared_genes, ]

  # Background estimate: small constant for Visium
  # SpatialDecon was designed for GeoMx where negative probes provide
  # background directly. For Visium, a small constant is standard practice.
  bg <- matrix(0.01, nrow = nrow(norm_sub), ncol = ncol(norm_sub),
               dimnames = dimnames(norm_sub))

  cat("  Running spatialdecon...\n")
  res <- tryCatch({
    spatialdecon(norm = norm_sub, bg = bg, X = profile_sub, align_genes = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ERROR:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(res)) next

  # beta: cell_types x spots -> transpose to spots x cell_types
  beta <- as.data.frame(t(res$beta))
  row_sums <- rowSums(beta); row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- 1
  beta_prop <- beta / row_sums

  beta_prop$barcode <- rownames(beta_prop)
  beta_prop$sample_id <- sid
  rl <- region_lookup[region_lookup$sample_id == sid, ]
  region_vec <- rl$region
  names(region_vec) <- rl$barcode
  beta_prop$region <- region_vec[beta_prop$barcode]

  spatialdecon_all[[sid]] <- beta_prop
  cat("  Done:", nrow(beta_prop), "spots,", ncol(beta_prop) - 3, "cell types\n")

  # Save full result (includes reverseDecon residuals)
  saveRDS(res, file.path(output_dir, paste0("spatialdecon_full_", sid, ".rds")))
}
```

# 4. Sanity Check: Marker Gene Correlation

Verify that each method's cell-type scores correlate with canonical marker
gene expression at the spot level.

```{r marker_correlation, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
markers <- list(
  Tumor             = c("EPCAM", "KRT20", "CDH1"),
  CD8_T             = c("CD8A", "CD8B", "TCF7", "IL7R", "LEF1", "SELL"),
  CD8_T_exhausted   = c("CXCL13", "TOX", "ENTPD1", "HAVCR2", "TIGIT", "PDCD1"),
  Macrophage        = c("CD68", "CD163", "CSF1R"),
  CAF               = c("FAP", "ACTA2", "COL1A1", "COL3A1"),
  DC                = c("CLEC9A", "CD1C", "FCER1A"),
  Treg              = c("FOXP3", "IL2RA", "CTLA4", "TIGIT")
)

cor_results <- list()

for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
  prep <- prepped[[sid]]
  expr <- tryCatch(
    as.matrix(GetAssayData(prep$seu, layer = "data", assay = "RNA")),
    error = function(e) as.matrix(GetAssayData(prep$seu, slot = "data", assay = "RNA"))
  )

  for (ct in names(markers)) {
    avail <- intersect(markers[[ct]], rownames(expr))
    if (length(avail) == 0) next
    marker_score <- if (length(avail) == 1) expr[avail, ] else colMeans(expr[avail, , drop = FALSE])

    for (method in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
      df <- switch(method,
                   "C2L" = c2l_all[[sid]],
                   "RCTD" = rctd_all[[sid]],
                   "SpatialDecon" = spatialdecon_all[[sid]])
      if (is.null(df) || !(ct %in% colnames(df))) next

      shared_bc <- intersect(names(marker_score), df$barcode)
      if (length(shared_bc) < 50) next

      r <- cor(df[[ct]][match(shared_bc, df$barcode)],
               marker_score[shared_bc],
               method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

      cor_results[[length(cor_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        sample = sid, cell_type = ct, method = method, spearman_r = r,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

cor_df <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = method, y = spearman_r, fill = method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Marker Gene Correlation by Method",
       subtitle = "Spearman r: deconvolution score vs mean marker expression per spot",
       y = "Spearman r", x = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "marker_correlation_boxplot.pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)

cor_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type, method) %>%
  summarise(mean_r = round(mean(spearman_r, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
            sd_r = round(sd(spearman_r, na.rm = TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = c(mean_r, sd_r)) %>%
  print()
```

# 5. Pathology Validation: Tumor Deconvolution vs Pathologist Annotations

The pathologist annotated each spot with a histology label (`cancer_cancer`
for tumor). This is independent of all three deconvolution methods and serves
as external ground truth. For each method, we ask: in spots the pathologist
called cancer, how much of the deconvolution signal is attributed to Tumor?
And conversely, in spots called benign, is the Tumor score low?

This directly validates whether mapping `cE*` → Tumor is reasonable.

```{r pathology_validation, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
path_results <- list()

for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
  prep <- prepped[[sid]]
  
  # Pathologist histology labels
  histology <- prep$meta$histology
  names(histology) <- rownames(prep$meta)
  
  # Binary: cancer vs non-cancer
  is_cancer <- rep("Non-cancer", length(histology))
  is_cancer[histology == "cancer_cancer"] <- "Cancer"
  names(is_cancer) <- names(histology)
  
  for (method in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
    df <- switch(method,
                 "C2L" = c2l_all[[sid]],
                 "RCTD" = rctd_all[[sid]],
                 "SpatialDecon" = spatialdecon_all[[sid]])
    if (is.null(df) || !("Tumor" %in% colnames(df))) next
    
    shared_bc <- intersect(names(is_cancer), df$barcode)
    if (length(shared_bc) < 50) next
    
    tumor_score <- df$Tumor[match(shared_bc, df$barcode)]
    path_label <- is_cancer[shared_bc]
    
    path_results[[length(path_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      sample = sid,
      method = method,
      barcode = shared_bc,
      pathology = path_label,
      tumor_score = tumor_score,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

path_df <- do.call(rbind, path_results)

# --- Box plot: Tumor score by pathology label and method ---
ggplot(path_df, aes(x = pathology, y = tumor_score, fill = method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~sample, ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Tumor Deconvolution Score vs Pathologist Annotation",
       subtitle = "Spots labeled 'cancer_cancer' by pathologist should have higher Tumor scores",
       y = "Tumor score (proportion or abundance)", x = "Pathologist label") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "pathology_validation_boxplot.pdf"), width = 12, height = 10)

# --- ROC-like analysis: can each method's Tumor score discriminate cancer? ---
library(pROC)

auc_results <- list()

for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
  for (method in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
    sub <- path_df[path_df$sample == sid & path_df$method == method, ]
    if (nrow(sub) < 50 || length(unique(sub$pathology)) < 2) next
    
    binary <- ifelse(sub$pathology == "Cancer", 1, 0)
    
    roc_obj <- tryCatch(
      roc(binary, sub$tumor_score, quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
      auc_results[[length(auc_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        sample = sid, method = method,
        auc = round(as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)), 3),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

if (length(auc_results) > 0) {
  auc_df <- do.call(rbind, auc_results)
  
  cat("\nAUC: Tumor score predicting pathologist cancer label\n")
  print(auc_df)
  
  ggplot(auc_df, aes(x = method, y = auc, fill = method)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    ylim(0.4, 1.0) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "AUC: Tumor Score vs Pathologist Cancer Annotation",
         subtitle = "Higher AUC = better agreement with pathology ground truth",
         y = "AUC", x = "") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "pathology_validation_auc.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
  write.csv(auc_df, file.path(output_dir, "pathology_validation_auc.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Summary by method
  auc_df %>%
    group_by(method) %>%
    summarise(mean_auc = round(mean(auc), 3),
              sd_auc = round(sd(auc), 3),
              min_auc = min(auc),
              max_auc = max(auc), .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()
}
```

# 6. Build Pseudobulk (IM Region)

Weight raw counts by cell-type proportions within the IM, aggregate per sample.

```{r pseudobulk}
de_types <- c("Tumor", "CD8_T_exhausted", "CD8_T", "CAF", "DC", "Macrophage", "Treg")

build_pseudobulk <- function(method_list, de_types, prepped) {
  pb_counts <- list()
  pb_meta   <- list()

  for (ct in de_types) {
    cat("  Pseudobulk:", ct, "\n")
    ct_counts <- list()
    ct_meta   <- list()

    for (sid in names(method_list)) {
      df <- method_list[[sid]]
      prep <- prepped[[sid]]
      if (!(ct %in% colnames(df))) next

      im_mask <- !is.na(df$region) & df$region == "IM"
      df_im <- df[im_mask, ]
      if (nrow(df_im) < 10) next

      raw <- tryCatch(
        GetAssayData(prep$seu, layer = "counts", assay = "RNA"),
        error = function(e) GetAssayData(prep$seu, slot = "counts", assay = "RNA")
      )

      shared_bc <- intersect(df_im$barcode, colnames(raw))
      if (length(shared_bc) < 10) next

      w <- df_im[[ct]][match(shared_bc, df_im$barcode)]
      w[is.na(w)] <- 0
      if (sum(w) == 0) next

      pb <- as.numeric(raw[, shared_bc, drop = FALSE] %*% w)
      names(pb) <- rownames(raw)

      lab <- paste0(sid, "_IM")
      ct_counts[[lab]] <- pb
      ct_meta[[lab]] <- data.frame(
        sample_label = lab, patient_id = sid, region = "IM",
        n_spots = length(shared_bc), sum_weight = sum(w),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    if (length(ct_counts) >= 4) {
      pb_counts[[ct]] <- do.call(cbind, ct_counts)
      pb_meta[[ct]]   <- do.call(rbind, ct_meta)
    } else {
      cat("    <4 samples, skipping\n")
    }
  }
  list(counts = pb_counts, meta = pb_meta)
}

cat("=== C2L ===\n");          pb_c2l    <- build_pseudobulk(c2l_all, de_types, prepped)
cat("\n=== RCTD ===\n");       pb_rctd   <- build_pseudobulk(rctd_all, de_types, prepped)
cat("\n=== SpatialDecon ===\n"); pb_sdecon <- build_pseudobulk(spatialdecon_all, de_types, prepped)
```

# 7. Differential Expression

Simplified limma model (n=6 is too small for the full interaction model).

```{r de_analysis}
clinical <- read.csv(meta_path)

# Derive mets_status from Distant_Mets and ln_only (same logic as Table 1 notebook)
clinical$mets <- ifelse(toupper(as.character(clinical$Distant_Mets)) %in% c("TRUE", "T"), "Distant_Mets",
                 ifelse(toupper(as.character(clinical$ln_only)) %in% c("TRUE", "T"), "LN_Mets",
                        "No_Mets"))

# Sample ID column
clinical$sid <- as.character(clinical$deident)

cat("Mets distribution:\n")
print(table(clinical$mets))

run_de <- function(count_mat, meta_df, clinical) {
  meta_df$mets_status <- clinical$mets[match(meta_df$patient_id, clinical$sid)]
  meta_df$mets_status <- factor(meta_df$mets_status,
                                 levels = c("No_Mets", "LN_Mets", "Distant_Mets"))
  meta_df$log_n_spots <- log(meta_df$n_spots)

  dge <- DGEList(counts = count_mat)
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = meta_df$mets_status)
  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  if (nrow(dge) < 50) return(NULL)

  design <- model.matrix(~ mets_status + log_n_spots, data = meta_df)
  v <- voom(dge, design)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)

  results <- list()
  for (coef_name in colnames(coef(fit))) {
    if (coef_name %in% c("(Intercept)", "log_n_spots")) next
    res <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
    res$gene <- rownames(res)
    res$contrast <- coef_name
    results[[coef_name]] <- res
  }
  results
}

de_results <- list()

for (ct in de_types) {
  cat("\n--- DE:", ct, "---\n")
  for (mn in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
    pb <- switch(mn, "C2L" = pb_c2l, "RCTD" = pb_rctd, "SpatialDecon" = pb_sdecon)
    if (is.null(pb$counts[[ct]])) { cat("  ", mn, ": skipped\n"); next }

    cat("  ", mn, ":")
    res <- tryCatch(run_de(pb$counts[[ct]], pb$meta[[ct]], clinical),
                    error = function(e) { cat(" ERROR\n"); NULL })
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      for (k in names(res)) {
        n <- sum(res[[k]]$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
        cat(" ", k, "=", n, ";")
      }
      cat("\n")
      de_results[[paste0(ct, "__", mn)]] <- res
    }
  }
}
```

# 8. Gene List Overlap (Jaccard)

```{r gene_overlap}
overlap_rows <- list()

for (ct in de_types) {
  for (contrast in c("mets_statusLN_Mets", "mets_statusDistant_Mets")) {
    gl <- list()
    for (m in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
      key <- paste0(ct, "__", m)
      if (!is.null(de_results[[key]][[contrast]])) {
        sig <- de_results[[key]][[contrast]]$gene[
          de_results[[key]][[contrast]]$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
        if (length(sig) > 0) gl[[m]] <- sig
      }
    }

    if (length(gl) >= 2) {
      ms <- names(gl)
      for (i in 1:(length(ms)-1)) for (j in (i+1):length(ms)) {
        a <- gl[[ms[i]]]; b <- gl[[ms[j]]]
        overlap_rows[[length(overlap_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
          cell_type = ct, contrast = contrast,
          method_a = ms[i], method_b = ms[j],
          n_a = length(a), n_b = length(b),
          n_shared = length(intersect(a, b)),
          jaccard = round(length(intersect(a,b)) / length(union(a,b)), 3),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }

      # UpSet if 3 methods
      if (length(gl) == 3) {
        all_g <- unique(unlist(gl))
        ud <- data.frame(row.names = all_g)
        for (m in names(gl)) ud[[m]] <- as.integer(all_g %in% gl[[m]])
        if (nrow(ud) > 0) {
          tryCatch(print(upset(ud, sets = names(gl), order.by = "freq",
                               main.bar.color = "steelblue",
                               text.scale = 1.3)),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

if (length(overlap_rows) > 0) {
  overlap_df <- do.call(rbind, overlap_rows)
  print(overlap_df)
  write.csv(overlap_df, file.path(output_dir, "gene_overlap_jaccard.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# 9. Effect Size Correlation

```{r lfc_correlation, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
lfc_all <- list()

for (ct in de_types) {
  for (contrast in c("mets_statusLN_Mets", "mets_statusDistant_Mets")) {
    lfc_list <- list()
    for (m in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
      key <- paste0(ct, "__", m)
      if (!is.null(de_results[[key]][[contrast]])) {
        d <- de_results[[key]][[contrast]][, c("gene", "logFC", "adj.P.Val")]
        colnames(d)[2:3] <- paste0(c("logFC_", "padj_"), m)
        lfc_list[[m]] <- d
      }
    }
    if (length(lfc_list) < 2) next

    merged <- lfc_list[[1]]
    for (i in 2:length(lfc_list)) merged <- merge(merged, lfc_list[[i]], by = "gene")
    if (nrow(merged) < 50) next

    merged$cell_type <- ct; merged$contrast <- contrast
    lfc_all[[length(lfc_all)+1]] <- merged

    # Scatter plots
    ms <- names(lfc_list)
    for (i in 1:(length(ms)-1)) for (j in (i+1):length(ms)) {
      c1 <- paste0("logFC_", ms[i]); c2 <- paste0("logFC_", ms[j])
      r <- cor(merged[[c1]], merged[[c2]], use = "complete.obs")
      p <- ggplot(merged, aes(.data[[c1]], .data[[c2]])) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, lty = 2, color = "red") +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.5) +
        labs(title = paste0(ct, " | ", gsub("mets_status", "", contrast)),
             subtitle = paste0(ms[i], " vs ", ms[j], " | r = ", round(r, 3))) +
        theme_bw()
      print(p)
    }
  }
}

if (length(lfc_all) > 0) {
  write.csv(do.call(rbind, lfc_all),
            file.path(output_dir, "lfc_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# 10. Summary Table

```{r summary_table, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
rows <- list()
for (ct in de_types) {
  for (contrast in c("mets_statusLN_Mets", "mets_statusDistant_Mets")) {
    for (m in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
      key <- paste0(ct, "__", m)
      if (!is.null(de_results[[key]][[contrast]])) {
        r <- de_results[[key]][[contrast]]
        ns <- sum(r$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
        top <- r[1, ]
        rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
          cell_type = ct, contrast = contrast, method = m,
          n_sig = ns,
          n_up = sum(r$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & r$logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
          n_down = sum(r$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & r$logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
          top_gene = top$gene,
          top_padj = signif(top$adj.P.Val, 3),
          top_lfc = round(top$logFC, 2),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

if (length(rows) > 0) {
  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  print(summary_df)
  write.csv(summary_df, file.path(output_dir, "de_summary_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  # Heatmap
  summary_df %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(cell_type, "\n", gsub("mets_status", "", contrast))) %>%
    select(label, method, n_sig) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = n_sig, values_fill = 0) -> sw

  mat <- as.matrix(sw[, -1]); rownames(mat) <- sw$label
  pheatmap(mat, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
           display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%d",
           main = "DE Genes (FDR < 0.05) by Method",
           color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "steelblue", "darkblue"))(50))
}
```

# 11. reverseDecon: Cell-Mixing vs Within-Cell-Type Variation

```{r reverse_decon, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
  rds_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("spatialdecon_full_", sid, ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(rds_path)) next

  res <- readRDS(rds_path)
  if (is.null(res$resids) || is.null(res$yhat)) next

  cat("\n=== reverseDecon: sample", sid, "===\n")

  observed <- res$yhat + res$resids
  fitted <- res$yhat

  gene_cors <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(observed)), function(i)
    cor(observed[i,], fitted[i,], use = "complete.obs"))
  names(gene_cors) <- rownames(observed)
  resid_sd <- apply(res$resids, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

  rdf <- data.frame(gene = names(gene_cors),
                     mixing_cor = gene_cors,
                     resid_sd = resid_sd[names(gene_cors)])

  p <- ggplot(rdf, aes(mixing_cor, resid_sd)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
    labs(title = paste("Sample", sid, "— reverseDecon"),
         x = "Correlation with cell-mixing prediction",
         y = "Residual SD") +
    theme_bw()

  # Highlight DE genes
  for (ct in de_types) {
    key <- paste0(ct, "__SpatialDecon")
    if (!is.null(de_results[[key]])) {
      for (cn in names(de_results[[key]])) {
        top_de <- de_results[[key]][[cn]]$gene[de_results[[key]][[cn]]$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
        hl <- rdf[rdf$gene %in% head(top_de, 10), ]
        if (nrow(hl) > 0) {
          p <- p + geom_point(data = hl, color = "red", size = 2) +
            ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = hl, aes(label = gene),
                                      color = "red", size = 3, max.overlaps = 15)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("reversedecon_", sid, ".pdf")), p, width = 8, height = 6)
}
```

# 12. Spatial Validation: Where Are the Top DE Genes Expressed?

For each method's top DE genes, plot their expression on the tissue alongside
the region annotations. If a gene is called DE in the IM, it should be
spatially enriched in the IM — not scattered uniformly or concentrated in the
CT. This is the architectural sanity check.

```{r spatial_validation, fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
n_top_genes <- 5  # top DE genes to plot per method/contrast

for (ct in de_types) {
  for (contrast in c("mets_statusLN_Mets", "mets_statusDistant_Mets")) {

    # Collect top genes from each method
    top_genes_by_method <- list()
    for (m in c("C2L", "RCTD", "SpatialDecon")) {
      key <- paste0(ct, "__", m)
      if (!is.null(de_results[[key]][[contrast]])) {
        res <- de_results[[key]][[contrast]]
        sig <- res[res$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
        if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
          sig <- sig[order(sig$adj.P.Val), ]
          top_genes_by_method[[m]] <- head(sig$gene, n_top_genes)
        }
      }
    }

    if (length(top_genes_by_method) == 0) next

    # Union of all top genes across methods
    all_top <- unique(unlist(top_genes_by_method))
    if (length(all_top) == 0) next

    cat("\n=== Spatial plots:", ct, "|", contrast, "===\n")
    cat("  Genes:", paste(all_top, collapse = ", "), "\n")

    # Which methods nominated each gene
    gene_source <- sapply(all_top, function(g) {
      paste(names(top_genes_by_method)[sapply(top_genes_by_method, function(x) g %in% x)],
            collapse = "+")
    })

    # Plot on each benchmark sample
    for (sid in benchmark_sids) {
      prep <- prepped[[sid]]

      expr <- tryCatch(
        as.matrix(GetAssayData(prep$seu, layer = "data", assay = "RNA")),
        error = function(e) as.matrix(GetAssayData(prep$seu, slot = "data", assay = "RNA"))
      )

      coords <- as.data.frame(prep$coords)
      colnames(coords)[1:2] <- c("x", "y")
      coords$barcode <- rownames(coords)

      meta <- region_lookup[region_lookup$sample_id == sid, c("barcode", "region")]

      # Merge coords + region
      plot_base <- merge(coords, meta[, c("barcode", "region")], by = "barcode")

      # Check which genes are available
      available <- intersect(all_top, rownames(expr))
      if (length(available) == 0) next

      # Get mets group for this sample
      mets_grp <- clinical$mets[match(sid, clinical$sid)]

      # Build plot list: region map + one per gene
      plot_list <- list()

      # Region reference map
      p_region <- ggplot(plot_base, aes(x = x, y = -y, color = region)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.3) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("CT" = "#E41A1C", "IM" = "#FF7F00",
                                       "Stroma" = "#377EB8", "Other" = "grey70")) +
        labs(title = paste0("Sample ", sid, " (", mets_grp, ") — Regions")) +
        theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                              plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
        coord_fixed()
      plot_list[["region"]] <- p_region

      # Gene expression maps
      for (gene in available) {
        gexpr <- expr[gene, ]
        gdf <- data.frame(barcode = names(gexpr), expression = as.numeric(gexpr))
        gdf <- merge(plot_base, gdf, by = "barcode")

        source_label <- gene_source[gene]

        p_gene <- ggplot(gdf, aes(x = x, y = -y, color = expression)) +
          geom_point(size = 0.3) +
          scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
          labs(title = paste0(gene, " [", source_label, "]"),
               color = "log-norm\nexpr") +
          theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "right",
                                plot.title = element_text(size = 9)) +
          coord_fixed()

        # Overlay IM boundary as a subtle outline
        im_spots <- plot_base[plot_base$region == "IM", ]
        if (nrow(im_spots) > 10) {
          p_gene <- p_gene +
            geom_point(data = im_spots, aes(x = x, y = -y),
                       color = "white", size = 0.5, shape = 1, alpha = 0.3,
                       inherit.aes = FALSE)
        }

        plot_list[[gene]] <- p_gene
      }

      # Arrange: region map + gene maps
      n_plots <- length(plot_list)
      ncols <- min(4, n_plots)
      nrows <- ceiling(n_plots / ncols)

      combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = ncols) +
        plot_annotation(
          title = paste0(ct, " DE genes | ", gsub("mets_status", "", contrast),
                         " | Sample ", sid, " (", mets_grp, ")"),
          theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
        )
      print(combined)

      ggsave(file.path(output_dir,
                        paste0("spatial_DE_", ct, "_", gsub("mets_status", "", contrast),
                               "_sample", sid, ".pdf")),
             combined, width = 16, height = 4 * nrows)
    }
  }
}
```
